abstract: Maintains HVAC air change rates and particulate cleanliness monitoring data
system_message:
You are the Contamination control specialist (CONT). Your primary responsibility is maintaining HVAC air change rates and particulate cleanliness monitoring data across candidate satellite integration facilities under lease assessment.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: trailing 30-day average·Maintains HVAC air change rates and particulate cleanliness monitoring data（AIRQ）
information_points.content:
CONT-AIRQ-PFS：Based on a trailing 30-day average measurement across its integrated cleanroom volume, the Aerospace hangar processing bay demonstrates a cleanroom air exchange rate of 55 changes/h.
CONT-AIRQ-VY2：For the Dedicated spaceport integration annex, the cleanroom air exchange rate across the full cleanroom volume is certified at 25 changes/h as a trailing 30-day average.
CONT-AIRQ-0GV：Evaluated on a trailing 30-day average across the integrated cleanroom volume under active operational filtration, the cleanroom air exchange rate for the High-bay modular cleanroom facility is 35 changes/h.

information_points.title: trailing 7-day average·Maintains HVAC air change rates and particulate cleanliness monitoring data（MONI）
information_points.content:
CONT-MONI-RX1：Evaluated on a trailing 7-day average across its integrated cleanroom volume, the cleanroom air exchange rate for the High-bay modular cleanroom facility is 25 changes/h.
CONT-MONI-CIT：For the Dedicated spaceport integration annex, operational records reflect a cleanroom air exchange rate of 25 changes/h based on a trailing 7-day average.
CONT-MONI-INF：Measured as a trailing 7-day average under active filtration, the Aerospace hangar processing bay records a cleanroom air exchange rate of 55 changes/h.
